answer_1.quote: We present the first results on Arabic GEC using Transformer-based pretrained Seq2Seq models... We benchmark ChatGPT (GPT-3.5) on the task of Arabic GEC... Most state-of-the-art (SOTA) GEC systems ... translate from erroneous to corrected texts.

answer_2.quote: We use the M2 scorer because it is language agnostic and was the main evaluation metric used in previous work on Arabic GEC.
